title: Payoff and Account Closure — Home Comfort Financing
content:
Account terms of Home Comfort Financing on payoff quotes and on closing an account as paid off.

**1. Payoff quote (retired clause).** The clause "A payoff quote is the balance on the quote date plus interest accruing daily to the payoff date" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded and is no longer the basis of the payoff amount.

**2. Quote validity (in force).** A payoff quote stays valid for the plan's payoff-quote validity period.

**3. When an account is paid off.** An account is paid off on the day its balance reaches 0.00 after every posted charge, including any deferred-interest assessment. A payment of less than the full balance never closes the account. An account is paid off only when its balance reaches 0.00; the balance on the account record decides it.

**4. Deferred-interest plans.** On a deferred-interest plan, paying the promotional balance in full by the end of the promotional end date avoids the deferred-interest assessment.

## Closure table

| Balance after the payment, every posted charge included | Account |
|---|---|
| 0.00 | paid off on that day |
| above 0.00 | stays open |

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

A borrower pays $4000.00 on an account whose balance, all posted charges included, is $4012.40. The balance after the payment is $12.40, so the account is not paid off and remains open.

superseded_clauses: A payoff quote is the balance on the quote date plus interest accruing daily to the payoff date
